unlabeled_first_impression: A warm intimate stage photograph of three musicians concentrating on one another, with a prominent lead guitarist, quiet active body language and readable real equipment. The main impression is restrained musical attention and the physical ease of a working trio.

intended_controls_comparison.binding: Frozen values remain sensual1, fetish0, surreal0, creativity1; this is configuration binding, not a perceptual score.
intended_controls_comparison.perceived_expression: The lead's natural expression, grounded stance and simple sleeveless clothing carry a subtle supporting attraction, while instrument activity remains dominant. No distinct fetish or surreal visual treatment is apparent.

whole_scene_strengths: The stage arrangement separates the amplifier/cable floor strip from shoes and exposes the drummer stool.
The near snare stick tip now visibly meets the head, connecting directed attention to actual actuation.
The shallow trio hierarchy keeps the lead face/hair and full guitar readable.
whole_scene_limitations: The short cable loop/junction by the guitar is ambiguous despite a much clearer floor route.
The lead's downward head may be read as a cue or checking fretting; actual rhythmic timing is not visible evidence.
The new lead face is turned farther downward than the earlier more frontal portrait, trading some immediate facial accessibility for playing concentration.
